entities.title: State the conformance profiles the library claims
entities.summary: The README states the library version and the specification versions it reads, but not which conformance profiles it claims or which registries it ships.
entities.expected: VERSIONING.md (Implementation versions): each library MUST state in its README which specification versions and which conformance profiles it supports; implementations/README.md also asks for the registries it ships or can load. The C#, Java and Python READMEs say "Conformance profiles claimed: none yet."
entities.observed: implementations/typescript/README.md lists Library version, Specification versions read, Contracts and Runtime dependencies, with no conformance-profile line and no registries line.
acceptanceCriteria: The README states the conformance profiles claimed (for example "none yet") and the registries it ships (none; zone rules are loaded from a file the caller names).
